title: Repair the quarantined Calendar Impact row layout
objective: Presentation-only repair of quarantined Calendar Impact rows so text, badge, times, counted state, and controls do not overlap at desktop or narrow width, while preserving classification, capacity, projection, and writer semantics (FEEDBACK-04/09/13 contracts).

root_cause.mechanism: The FEEDBACK-13 desktop row grid pins the class cell to a fixed 64px track (116px minmax(160px,1fr) 64px 70px 92px 124px auto). The class badge is width:fit-content at 10px uppercase; 'QUARANTINED' measures ~80px, wider than the 64px track, so the pill overflowed into the adjacent 70px duration track and visually collided with the '2hr' readout. Fixed/work/ignored badges are short enough to fit, which is why the compressed and overlapping row appeared only for quarantined events.
root_cause.evidence: Live screenshot (supplied) shows compressed and overlapping quarantined row; reproduced in component test by asserting the badge containment declarations were absent from app.css (Red).

frontend_production: frontend/src/app.css: .calendar-impact__class gains max-width:100%, overflow:hidden, text-overflow:ellipsis, white-space:nowrap. The badge now caps at its grid track and ellipsizes instead of spilling into the duration cell at desktop widths.
fix.frontend_component: none — CalendarImpact.tsx unchanged; the row grid, cell order, and DOM structure already carry the FEEDBACK-13 hierarchy.

behavior: quarantined row renders every cell (time 8 PM–10 PM, event, badge quarantined, duration 2hr, count 0 blk counted, reason Not counted, actions) in the documented FEEDBACK-13 hierarchy order
class badge containment CSS exists (max-width 100%, overflow hidden, text-overflow ellipsis, white-space nowrap) — the quarantined pill cannot overlap the duration cell
narrow ≤767px media keeps the badge in its own 116px column with containment (base rule) so it never bleeds into the flexible column
quarantined stays Not counted / 0 blk counted / no hard-block affordance; fixed + work rows keep hard block, Inside work budget, and accounting
all visible row times are authoritative 12-hour (AM/PM present, no bare HH:MM)
FEEDBACK-13 desktop grid, event min-width:0, narrow re-template, and attend span-full-width contracts unchanged

revision.title: Resolve FEEDBACK-17 TypeScript test errors

root_cause.mechanism: The harness ui() returns ReturnType<typeof render>; destructured container loses DOM querySelectorAll typing through that inferred ReturnType, so Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(...)) produced TS2339 (property does not exist) and the find callback param widened to unknown (TS18046) at the row selection.

fix.frontend_test_typing: feedback17.test.tsx pins the receiver to the DOM-lib Element type: const box: Element = container; then Array.from(box.querySelectorAll('.calendar-impact__row')).find((el) => el.textContent?.includes('Steelers Game')). Type annotation only; runtime behavior identical (Element cast is erased).

revision.regression_test: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit over include src) is the regression gate; it previously failed on feedback17.test.tsx TS18046/TS2339 at lines 87/90/91 and now exits clean with the pin fix.
